description: 繁體中文：Nivqo Manager 1.35.0 正式版，整合上游 Morphe Manager 1.35.0，並更新 HushFacebook 0.10.0-nivqo.1（87 個 Patch）與 HushMessenger 0.22.0-nivqo.1（43 個 Patch／37 個控制項）。Nivqo Patches 0.6.0 共 130 個 Patch；保留繁體中文／English 語言選擇、獨立品牌、Facebook 頂部 Messenger 雙向路由以及正式核心的更新／重新修補提示。Morphe Patcher 維持 1.15.1。English: Nivqo Manager 1.35.0 syncs formal Morphe Manager 1.35.0, HushFacebook 0.10.0-nivqo.1 (87 patches), and HushMessenger 0.22.0-nivqo.1 (43 patches / 37 controls). The combined source has 130 patches. Preserves Nivqo branding, Traditional Chinese localization and core re-patch update notifications.
